prompt_head:
Role: Staff Software Engineer, AI Engineering at Tebra
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 8+ years professional software engineering experience bu

assessments.note: Shows about 4 years building platforms and edge systems, short of the 8+ years asked.
Python and FastAPI shown; no Java or Spring Boot evidence.
Multiple shipped AI agent applications over about 4 years.
Built a LangGraph agent in production-style workflow.
RAG and prompting shown; tool calling and human-in-the-loop not evidenced.
Data pipelines shown; no Kafka or event-driven messaging evidence.
Langfuse tracing shown; no evaluation pipeline or fallback mechanisms evidenced.
Led modernization and validation work; influence without authority is not explicit.
No evidence of cross-functional communication with Product, Design, or Operations.
Cloud work is on Cloudflare; no AWS, Azure, or GCP evidence.
Agent graphs and RAG shown; multi-tier memory and recursive reasoning not evidenced.
No healthcare, RCM, billing, claims, or fintech experience in the evidence.
Hands-on pgvector vector search shown; knowledge graph work not evidenced.
Uses embeddings via RAG; no PyTorch, Transformers, or fine-tuning evidence.
Founder role building AI systems, but no platform lead role at a company.

output.verdict_line: Strong AI agent and orchestration fit, but the candidate is short on years, Java and Spring Boot, and messaging systems for this Staff role.
top_gaps: 8+ years of distributed systems experience (candidate has about 4)
Java and Spring Boot backend experience
